transcript.statement: Performance efficiency is crucial for a bookkeeping system to ensure that transactions are processed swiftly and that users can access information without delay. My requirements EFF-01 and EFF-04 ensure responsiveness and timely report generation, while EFF-02 guarantees the system can handle multiple users concurrently, crucial for business environments. EFF-03 aims to minimize memory usage, and EFF-05 focuses on reducing latency through caching. EFF-06 and EFF-07 emphasize the importance of fast currency conversion and minimal logging delays to enhance user experience. These requirements collectively support an efficient and responsive system.

transcript.statement: Safety and reliability are paramount in a bookkeeping system to prevent data loss, corruption, and discrepancies. My requirements ensure accurate transaction recording (SAF-01), integrity through double-entry principles (SAF-02), and an audit trail for accountability (SAF-03). Error handling (SAF-04) and safe degradation (SAF-05) are essential for maintaining functionality during faults. Validating currency conversions (SAF-06) prevents financial discrepancies, while regular backups (SAF-07) safeguard against data loss. These requirements support a trustworthy and resilient system, which is critical for users' financial data security.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure all financial transactions are recorded accurately while maintaining safety and performance.
The system shall implement double-entry bookkeeping principles to ensure integrity and prevent discrepancies.
The system shall maintain an immutable audit trail of all transactions for at least 7 years.
The system shall provide error handling mechanisms to manage and recover from faults during transaction processing.
The system shall ensure safe degradation, allowing access to essential functionalities during partial outages.
The system shall validate currency conversions to ensure accuracy and prevent discrepancies.
The system shall perform regular backups of financial data to prevent loss in case of failures.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are processed efficiently within an acceptable timeframe.
The system shall support concurrent processing of at least 100 users to ensure adequate throughput.
The system shall utilize efficient data structures to minimize memory usage by 20% compared to traditional methods.
The system shall generate financial reports in under 5 seconds for datasets up to 10,000 transactions.
The system shall implement caching to reduce latency by at least 50%.
The system shall ensure that currency conversion operations complete within 3 seconds.
The system shall minimize energy consumption during data processing using efficient algorithms.
The system shall implement compliance with applicable financial regulations and standards.
The system shall implement user access controls to ensure that only authorized personnel can modify transactions.
The system shall log all financial transactions with timestamps and user identifiers.
The system shall provide functionalities to detect and alert users about potential financial discrepancies.
The system shall support reporting that complies with local and international accounting standards.
The system shall ensure compliance with sustainability regulations relevant to financial systems.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are encrypted during transmission and storage.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict user permissions based on roles.
The system shall validate data input to prevent unauthorized or malicious data entry.
The system shall support two-factor authentication for all users accessing financial data.
The system shall ensure that users can only access data relevant to their assigned accounts.
